Date, Time and Place: Sealed bids will be received until 10:00 A.M. (C.D.S.T.) on

at 901 Walter Sillers Building, 550 High Street, Jackson, Mississippi 39201 for the purchase of the above Lease Revenue Certificates of Participation (Series 1997A) (the Certificates''). Security and Terms: The Certificates will be dated their date of delivery, which shall be on or about May 7, 1997, and evidence a proportionate interest in lease payments to be made by the State of Mississippi, represented by and acting through the State of Mississippi Department of Finance and Administration, as lessee (the State''), for the lease-purchase of certain equipment acquired pursuant to a Master Lease Purchase Agreement (the Master Lease'') between Carlyle Capital Markets Inc. (CCMI''), as lessor, and the State, as lessee. Pursuant to a Trust Indenture, as supplemented (the ''
), executed b
CCMI, the State, and First Tennessee Bank National

Association, as Trustee, CCMI has assigned to the Trustee all of CCMI's right, title and interest in and to the Master Lease, including the right to receive all payments under the Master Lease and the security interest in the Equipment acquired pursuant to the Master Lease. The State is required under the Master Lease to make lease payments from legally available funds, subject to annual appropriation, and the scheduled lease payments, together with investment earnings thereon, are sufficient to pay, when due, the semiannual payments of interest and the annual payments of principal on the Certificates. The obligation of the State to make lease payments does not constitute an obligation of the State for which the State is obligated to levy or pledge any form of taxation. The obligation of the State to make lease payments does not constitute debt of the State. The Certificates will bear interest, payable on October 15, 1997, and semiannually thereafter on the 15th day of April and October, at such rate or rates per annum as designated by the successful bidder in its official bid and will mature on April 15 of each year beginning April 15, 1998 through April 15, 2002.
Redemption Features: The Certificates will be subjec

redemption as set forth in the Indenture. Bid Amount: A bid must be for all the Certificates and for a purchase price of par, plus accrued interest, if any. Information: Copies of the Preliminary Offering Circular, the Official Notice of Sale, and the Official Bid Form in connection with the Certificates, and information concerning continuing disclosure may be obtained from the following:
Friedman, Luzzatto & Co.
14755 Preston Road, Suite 424
Dallas, Texas 75240

verification of the bids.
(From The Bond Buyer)
